skill.name: telegram-integration
skill.description: Use when user explicitly requests Telegram bot development, Mini App integration, webhook/polling setup, or debugging Telegram-specific issues. Handles Telegraf-based bots, AI chatbot integration via Telegram, and deployment to Railway/Vercel. DO NOT use unless user mentions Telegram work.

generated_query: I’m building a Telegram bot that lets users subscribe to weather alerts for their city. The bot needs to handle /start and /subscribe commands, store user preferences, and send daily forecasts via polling during development. I’m using Telegraf and deploying to Railway. Can you help set up the bot structure, the polling logic for local testing, and then configure the webhook for production? Also, I need to integrate a free weather API to fetch alerts.
